We're bringing you the biggest Secret River Confluence vlog from Ghatshila Ratmohona!
Video Highlights and Timestamps:
In this new adventure, we covered:
Ratmohona's 'Secret' Confluence Point where two rivers meet.
The Broken Bridge: A 100-year-old British-era broken bridge.
The stunning view of the Suvarnarekha River and Ratmohona Waterfall near Ghatshila.
The best time to visit and how to reach this amazing Picnic Spot.
